name: QR Code Generator
description: Render a QR code, or read the content of a QR code from an image.

results.pixelsHint: Modules per side × pixels per module

hints.text: The content may be up to 4096 bytes; beyond that the code grows large and scans poorly.
hints.textTooLong: The content exceeds 4096 bytes. Shorten it before generating.
hints.size: The module size is between 1 and 40 pixels and defaults to 6.
hints.margin: The quiet zone is the blank border, between 0 and 16 modules, defaulting to 4.
hints.ecLevel: A higher level tolerates more obstruction and dirt, but the code also gets denser.
hints.fg: Foreground and background colors use the `#RRGGBB` form; leave them empty for the default black on white.
hints.image: PNG and JPEG are supported, up to 4 MB per image.
hints.output: The result ships both a vector SVG and a raster PNG; the SVG source can be copied directly.

faq.q: Which error correction level should I use?
faq.a: M is fine for ordinary printing; use H when half the code may be covered or carries a logo; use L when the smallest possible code matters.

faq.q: Why did reading the image fail?
faq.a: Usually the QR code in the picture is too small, too blurry, or surrounded by noisy patterns. Make sure the file is a PNG or JPEG first.
